cds.title: University of Memphis Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 first-year class (CDS C1: 12,641 applicants = 4,783 men + 7,857 women + 1 unknown; 9,958 admitted). The CDS leaves the residency split (in-state / out-of-state / international) blank, so intl applicants and admits are not recorded; first-time nonresident enrollees were 43 and total nonresident undergraduates 307 (B2). Only 5% of enrollees (97 students) submitted SAT versus 90% (1,842) ACT, so SAT percentiles describe a small group. No early decision, early action or wait list. C8F says test scores are required unless waived by a particularly strong high school GPA (and still recommended).

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5/H6. The CDS box says 2026-27 costs were not yet available (expected September 2026), so these are most likely 2025-26 rates. Tuition shown is the nonresident-alien rate ($24,360) plus required fees $2,016; other = transportation $3,966 + other $2,880. H6: 165 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $18,732. The admissions page 'F-1 Undergraduate International Estimated Cost of Attendance' lists tuition and fees of $20,040 for one year, living about $13,000, books $1,000 and a required proof of funding of $32,824.
